title: What Is the Rising Action of a Story? — Writing Activity
skills: define rising action within a story
identify events that increase conflict and tension
sequence plot events leading toward the climax
apply rising-action concepts in narrative writing
alignment_note: Introduces rising action as the sequence of events that develops conflict and builds tension toward a story's climax. Supports plot analysis, sequencing, narrative structure, and application of rising-action concepts in original writing across high school English courses.
